features.title: The model picker follows connected account changes
features.summary: Session model catalogs share a bounded Host cache, invalidated immediately by adapter, settings and credential changes instead of retaining a pre-account snapshot.
failureModes: A stale in-flight result cannot repopulate the cache after a later registry commit.

verification.testName: immediately advertises a newly registered account and its renamed route

features.title: Guarded thread-local model selection
features.summary: Expose one supported Host/client/Agent contract for reading and changing local model intent without saving global defaults or enqueuing input. Validate the target, recheck the native selection revision and queued work at commit, and synchronously persist selection plus provider-preference annotation. Capture request intent at the native assembly boundary so stale automatic recovery cannot overwrite a newer choice. Ordinary model-picker behavior remains unchanged.
failureModes: Agents may access only their own thread; UI/Host callers must name a thread.
Archived and runtime-owned subagent threads are refused, including cold persisted subagents.
A stale revision or pending waking input refuses the write without changing selection or defaults.
Native model identifiers remain compatible with the installed runtime; unrelated plugin records cannot grant preference.

verification.testName: thread-local selection commits adjacent durable intent without saving the global default or waking input
rechecks CAS after model resolution awaits rather than overwriting an intervening picker selection
does not reject valid native model identifiers merely because they exceed a handoff UI length
grants preference only through the immediately adjacent public plugin record
public LlmRuntime registration, same-route replacement, disposal and directory updates invalidate the bound catalog synchronously

features.title: Send the browser only what a thread renders
features.summary: Opening and following a thread sends its events without provider replay state, which only the Host needs to continue a conversation.
failureModes: The Host keeps replay state in the Session log; only the browser copy omits it.
reach: expect textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions"

verification.testName: drops provider replay state from assistant events and keeps everything else

telemetry.testName: records a session tail read span with the thread, bytes and frames it read

features.title: Drive threads from another plugin
features.summary: The sessions API lets a plugin or a browser create a thread, prompt it, run its commands, add a message on its behalf, compact, interrupt, wait for it, switch its model or agent preset, keep keyed instructions in its system prompt, and make one-off model calls.
failureModes: A native refusal (unknown thread, busy agent) reaches the caller with its own message and a session-* code.
A command the thread does not offer fails with command-unavailable instead of running nothing.
Keyed instructions need the profile's storage-domain row; without it setInstruction fails with storage-unavailable.

verification.testName: prompts a thread, waits for its turn, and carries keyed instructions in every later request
adds a plugin message that waits for the next turn unless asked to wake the thread
generates outside any thread, decoding a JSON Schema reply
